title: CliniDAO
tagline: To store clinical trial data for drug discovery purpose, accelerating the speed while reducing the cost by the data owner sharing data with other researcher.  The AI/ML component creates additional VALUE-ADD.
description: This project has a narrower scope of storing clinical trial data even though this data volume is huge. The idea is to allow researchers to store their clinical research and field trial data in decentralized manner and be able to share partial/full sets of data with other researcher for a fee that makes drug discovery process easier. There would be a AI/ML component that will build insights on the stored data and add additional value add not only the owner but also the user of the data.
how_its_made:
This project is currently on the ideation phase. We want to build a tool sets that allow i) permanent storage of clinical trial data  ii) monetize on the data by sharing with other researchers and communities. iii) the AI/ML component will create additional VALUE for the stored data  for both the owner and user of data while accelerating the drug-discovery process and reducing cost.

For now, I took the FEVM Hardhat Kit repo and was able to compile the code, connect my MetMask wallet to Walloby TestNet and deploy  SimpleCoin.sol and mock MarketAPI and MinerAPI solidity contracts and was able to execute different methods of the contracts.
